questions.solution_en:
Sum of diagonally opposite
Alphabets = 19
A + R = 1 + 18 = 19
G + L = 7 + 12 = 19
Similarly
1 = 9 ⇒ 19 – 9 = 10
And J = 10
So, J is the answer.

And J = 10
अतः J ही उत्तर है।
